data.gender_notes: Adelice is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Adele, meaning 'just' or 'noble'. In Greek mythology, Adele was a goddess of justice and fairness. The name Adelice carries the meaning “Noble, just” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adelice usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, just and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adelice total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אדליס
in_hebrew.meaning: אדליס היא שם שפירושו אצילה ומיוחדת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אדליס הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית ופירושו אצילה ומיוחדת. השם אדליס הוא גרסה של השם אדלייד, שפירושו אבילית או אצילה. השם אדליס משמש כנראה כגרסה נשית של השם אדל, שפירושו אציל. השם אדליס נמצא בשימוש בעיקר במסגרת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Αδελίκη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αδελίκη είναι ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Adelaide, που σημαίνει Ευγενής. Η προέλευση του ονόματος βρίσκεται στη γερμανική λέξη 'adal', που σημαίνει ευγενής και 'heid', που σημαίνει φύση ή μορφή. Το όνομα Αδελίκη χρησιμοποιήθηκε από την αρχή ως όνομα για κορίτσια στην Ευρώπη και έχει σχέση με την ευγένεια και την υψηλή κοινωνία.

in_latin.name: Adelice
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Adelice originates from the Germanic word 'adal', meaning noble. This name evolved into various forms across Europe, such as Adelaide in English. Adelice signifies a person of noble birth or character. The name Adelice was popularized in the Christian tradition due to Saint Adelaide, a 10th-century German empress.

in_english.name: Adelice
in_english.meaning: Noble and kind, derived from Germanic roots
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adelice is derived from the Germanic words 'adal', meaning noble, and 'heid', meaning kind or nature. It shares its roots with the name Adelaide, which was popularized by Saint Adelaide, a 10th-century German empress and wife of Emperor Otto I. Adelice symbolizes nobility, kindness, and generosity, reflecting the virtues highly valued in Christian tradition. Historically, the name Adelice has been used in various European cultures, particularly in medieval England and France.
